name: 53578 · Pr Du Sac, WI
findings: ZIP 53578 (Pr Du Sac) has 34 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53578 (Pr Du Sac) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
56% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 53578 (Pr Du Sac) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.1 times the typical level).

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
